title: Remove positional GWT learning IDs and separate uptake from outcome credit
completion_test_prose: Use durable_memory.memory_id, turns.turn_id and Hyperposition relation_id as persistent candidate identities; never use a positional slot as a learning key. Add fail-closed nonlearnable fallback when stable identity is absent. Pass per-source permutation tests proving boosts follow objects rather than slots. Split immediate citation/uptake evidence from strong persistent outcome credit and run the four-arm correct/cited, correct/uncited, wrong/cited, forced-ID falsifier. Do not award whole-loop learning credit until wrong or forced citations fail to earn strong persistent reward.
rationale_prose: The schema and projector already contain stable identities, so positional aliasing is an adapter defect rather than a missing ontology. The current learning call also runs before lifecycle completion and derives reward from the same answer that consumed the broadcast; citation is therefore useful uptake evidence but not independent outcome evidence.
